title: Studies in Islamic Mysticism
author: Reynold A. Nicholson
description: Reynold A. Nicholson examines the ideas and experiences of Islamic mystics. The work introduces Sufi approaches to divine love, spiritual knowledge and the relationship between the individual soul and ultimate reality.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/studiesinislamyst00nichuoft).
